newsitem.title: FRANCE: French president cuts back on traditional pardon.
newsitem.headline: French president cuts back on traditional pardon.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac will exclude drug dealers and paedophiles from this year's annual presidential pardon to be issued on the July 14 national holiday, his aides said on Friday.
Those qualifying for the pardon will benefit from a reduction of one week for every month of the rest of their sentences, with a four-month maximum reduction.
According to the Catholic daily La Croix, the decree, which Chirac has already signed, will result in the release of 3,840 prisoners over the four weeks following its implementation on July 16.
People guilty of corruption, terrorist acts or committing violence against police are normally excluded.

Traditionally, those convicted of serious crimes against children under 15 and drug trafficking also do not qualify for the pardon, but this year Chirac added to that category indecency involving children as well as petty drug dealers.
